about: tools/art/boss-prompts.json - source of every boss sprite generation prompt (tools/art/gen-codex.cjs builds the exact text, writes the import specs and the PRODUCTION.md appendix). Pose names starting with '_' are the idle reference pose that opens every sheet: it fixes the sheet's scale and is not imported as a frame. Durations are 60 Hz frames.

text.style: Early-1990s Capcom CPS-1 arcade beat-'em-up sprite pixel art (the look of Cadillacs & Dinosaurs, 1993): hard pixel clusters, a clean one-pixel near-black outline around the whole figure, 3-4 tone colour ramps per material, at most 16 colours in total, large readable shapes and a strong silhouette, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no dithering noise, no painterly texture.
text.view: Every pose is a strict side view (profile) FACING LEFT: the character's face and chest point toward the LEFT edge of the image.
text.background: Perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta background everywhere. No floor, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no numbers, no borders, no frames, and no sound waves, sparks, water, smoke or other effects detached from the body.
text.sheet: {n} full-body poses in ONE horizontal row, left to right in the order listed, evenly spaced, with wide empty magenta gaps so that no two poses touch or overlap (weapons, tails and claws included). All feet stand on the same invisible horizontal ground line (except poses described as airborne or lying down). Same character, same proportions, same colours and the same pixel size in every pose.
text.single: ONE full-body pose, centred, with a wide empty magenta margin on every side.
text.refModel: The attached image {ref} is the locked model of this character: copy its design, colours and proportions exactly; pose 1 repeats that model's idle stance unchanged.
text.refBoard: The attached concept board {ref}: use {panel} as the design reference (ignore its background, labels and the other characters) and turn it into a clean game sprite.
text.finish: Do not edit, resize, recolour or post-process the generated image. After generating, copy the generated PNG unchanged into the current folder as {file}.
text.refPose: IDLE REFERENCE: the same idle stance as the attached model, unchanged (it keeps the scale)

bosses.name: WARDEN ROOK
bosses.lock: Warden Rook, a weathered muscular HUMAN dock jailer in his forties: shaved bald head, heavy black horseshoe moustache, crooked nose, stern brow; bare sinewy forearms with black leather wrist cuffs; a sleeveless faded ORANGE flotation vest with grey buckles over a NAVY short-sleeved shirt; dark NAVY rolled waterproof trousers with cream turn-ups; big black-brown sea boots; a coil of tan rope hanging from the belt at the hip; a LONG steel boat hook (gaff) with a fork-and-hook head and brass grips, about 1.3 times his height, held in two hands. Not fat, no cleavers, no mohawk, no hat. Main colours: orange against navy, skin, steel grey, rope tan, dark boot brown.

poses: IDLE: fighting stance, knees bent, the hook held across the body in both hands with its head pointing forward-left at waist height
IDLE BREATH: the same stance with the shoulders slightly lower and the hook head dipped a little
WALK: left leg stepping forward, heel down, hook carried across the body
WALK: legs passing under the body, rear knee lifted
WALK: right leg stepping forward, heel down, hook carried across the body
WALK: legs passing, the other knee lifted
HOOK TELL: crouched, weight on the back leg, the hook head lowered to ankle height in front of him, eyes on the target
HOOK THRUST: long lunge forward, both arms fully extended, the hook jabbed straight out far to the left at chest height
HOOK PULL: leaning far back, the hook yanked back to the hip with both hands, front foot braced
RECOVERY: over-committed stumble forward, the hook tip dragging on the ground, head low and open
HURT HIGH: head snapped back, body recoiling, the hook held loosely in one hand
HURT LOW: doubled over from a hit to the gut, hook held low
KNOCKED DOWN: airborne, falling backwards off his feet, legs in the air
LYING FLAT on his back on the ground, whole body horizontal, the hook beside him
GETTING UP: on one knee, pushing himself up on the hook
DEFEATED: kneeling on both knees, slumped, hands raised in surrender, the hook dropped on the ground in front

bosses.name: BREAKWATER
bosses.lock: Breakwater, a squat powerful four-legged ANKYLOSAUR and a living captive animal (not a monster, not evil): blunt beaked head carried low; ochre-yellow broad armoured back of rounded plates with a few short blunt studs (no long spikes); dark blue-grey belly, legs and face; thick stubby legs; a short thick tail ending in a big round grey-brown TAIL CLUB; two orange padded cargo-harness bands around the body with shiny brass release clamps and a short broken tow chain hanging from the harness. No rider, no turret, no horns. Body length including the tail about 2.4 times its height.

poses: IDLE: standing square on all four legs, head low, tail club resting behind
BREATHING: head raised slightly, sides expanded
WALK: front-left and back-right legs stepping forward
WALK: legs passing under the body
WALK: front-right and back-left legs stepping forward
TAIL TELL: body twisted, the tail club swung far up and out behind, head turned to look back
TAIL SWEEP mid-swing: body pivoting, the club swinging low past its side
TAIL SWEEP follow-through: the club stretched out low along the ground, body half turned
RECOVERY: winded, chin on the ground, the harness bands and brass clamps on its flank clearly exposed
HURT: flinching, head jerked up, eyes squeezed shut
CHARGE: head down, legs driving, lunging forward at a run
FREED: the harness bands snapped and falling away, head raised, calm

bosses.name: GLASSBACK
bosses.lock: Glassback, a tall pear-shaped feathered THERIZINOSAUR mother (a protective animal, not evil): long slender neck, small birdlike beaked head with a bright eye; broad ochre-yellow chest; deep green feathered back and shoulders; cream-white feathered forearms each ending in THREE unmistakable very long curved ivory claws; heavy grey scaled legs with big three-toed feet; a short-to-medium feathered tail; one simple orange sonic collar with a small brass box around the neck. No armour, no glass on the body.

poses: IDLE: protective display, upright, claws held half-raised in front of the chest, neck curved
BREATHING: chest raised, claws slightly opened
WALK: left foot stepping forward, body leaning, claws folded
HIGH TELL: rearing up tall, both clawed arms raised and CROSSED high above the head
HIGH SWEEP: both claws slashing down and forward in a long arc at head height, body leaning forward
LOW TELL: crouched low, neck pulled back, claws drawn back close to the ground
LOW RAKE: claws raking forward along the ground, body low and stretched forward
RECOVERY: off balance after the rake, claws stuck down, neck low
HURT: recoiling, neck twisted back, feathers ruffled
CALMED: settled low on the ground, arms spread protectively over the ground as over a nest, head lowered, peaceful

bosses.name: FOREMAN CINDER
bosses.lock: Foreman Cinder, a short squat HUMAN salvage foreman with a deep barrel chest, broad stance and heavy work boots: a battered cream-brass diving helmet tilted OPEN to show a scarred determined stubbled face; a rust-red cut-down pressure suit with brass rivets; ONE huge yellow-and-black striped pneumatic PILE-DRIVER braced along the forearm nearest the viewer (a hammer-shaped block bigger than his torso) with a small round pressure gauge on it; the other hand small in a dark work glove; a brass air tank on his back with one black hose to the driver. Not a robot, not a mech. Shorter and much wider than the other humans.

poses: IDLE: braced wide stance, the pile-driver held low and forward, the free fist clenched
BREATHING: the driver lifted slightly, chest expanded
HEAVY WALK: left boot stepping forward, the driver swinging
HEAVY WALK: right boot stepping forward
HEAVY WALK: legs passing, opposite phase
SLAM TELL: the pile-driver raised high above his head, the gauge needle in the red, leaning back
SLAM: the pile-driver smashed down into the floor in front of him, crouched low over it
STUCK: the driver jammed in the floor, pulling at it with both hands, back exposed
VENT: hunched, one hand twisting the valve on his back tank
HURT HIGH: head snapped back inside the open helmet
LYING FLAT on his back, whole body horizontal, the driver beside him
GETTING UP: on one knee, pushing up on the driver
DEFEATED: sitting slumped against the dead pile-driver, helmet pushed off

bosses.name: DR. ECHO
bosses.lock: Dr. Echo, a lean tall older HUMAN woman scientist: silver swept-back hair, a sharp face, round tinted safety goggles pushed up on the brow; a bone-white long split lab raincoat over a dark plum fitted top; very dark plum trousers and black boots; a folded crescent-shaped directional acoustic DISH with a brass rim strapped to her back above one shoulder (no wider than her shoulders); a short brass tuning-fork controller in one hand. Scientific salvage gear: no rifle, no magic staff, no glowing effects.

poses: IDLE: upright, the tuning-fork controller raised, the other hand on the dish strap
BREATHING: coat hem shifted, controller lowered slightly
WALK: left leg stepping forward, coat swinging
DISH TELL: the dish swung over her shoulder and pointed forward-left, body braced, controller raised
SONIC BURST: the dish aimed straight forward at chest height, leaning into it, coat blown back (no sound waves drawn)
COOLDOWN: dish lowered, hunched forward catching her breath, her side exposed
FORK JAB: quick step forward, jabbing the tuning fork at arm's length
HURT HIGH: head snapped back, goggles askew
LYING FLAT on her back, whole body horizontal, dish beside her
CAPTURED: kneeling, hands raised, the dish dropped behind her

bosses.name: MARSHAL SABLE
bosses.lock: Marshal Sable, an imposing middle-aged HUMAN water marshal: athletic with a thick neck (not a bodybuilder), close-cropped dark hair with grey temples, a clear diagonal scar across his LEFT cheek, stern square jaw; a long dark PETROL-GREEN military stormcoat with brass buttons; an IVORY sash diagonally across the chest; ONE broad BRASS floodgate-shaped plate on the left shoulder; black gloves; a heavy black pistol in one hand; a square brass pressure regulator on the belt; worn black rubber boots. No crown, no throne.

poses: IDLE: upright authoritarian stance, the pistol lowered at his side
BREATHING: chest raised slightly, coat hem shifted
WALK: measured step, left leg forward
AIM TELL: pistol raised at arm's length pointing forward-left at chest height, the other hand behind his back
FIRE: arm extended, the pistol kicked up slightly by recoil
FIRE AGAIN: stronger recoil, shoulder pushed back
RELOAD: head down looking at the opened pistol, feeding a magazine, open to attack
HURT HIGH: head snapped back, coat flaring
PISTOL-WHIP: stepping in and swinging the pistol butt forward
TRANSFORM 1: clutching the brass shoulder plate, doubled over in pain
TRANSFORM 2: shoulder swelling, the brass plate splitting, coat sleeve tearing, green scales spreading up the neck
TRANSFORM 3: half transformed and bigger, the forearm swollen huge and scaled, crocodile jaw forming, crouching and bracing the huge hand on the ground

bosses.name: CROWNBACK
bosses.panel: panel 02 / CROWNBACK (top right; also the creature in the bottom arena scene)
bosses.lock: Crownback, Marshal Sable's original mutant final form: a broad, low, hunched amphibious reptile-human brute with TWO arms, TWO heavy digitigrade hind legs, ONE head and a SHORT thick crocodilian tail (the tail no longer than the body; the whole creature including the tail no wider than 1.5 times its crouched height); dark PETROL-GREEN armoured scales simplified into large readable plates; a broad pale OCHRE belly; ONE HUGE shield-like left forearm of fused armour plates (a living floodgate) and one smaller humanlike clawed right hand; a short heavy crocodilian muzzle carrying Sable's square brow and the diagonal scar on the left cheek, an intelligent angry eye, a short thick neck; THREE blunt slab-like bony dorsal plates on the upper back; a cracked brass shoulder plate, the torn ivory sash still diagonal across the chest, scraps of dark green trousers and the square brass belt regulator; warm coral-orange gill slits on the ribs. Flesh, not a robot or mech; no horns, no crown, no wings, no spikes, no extra heads, no pink flesh.

poses: IDLE: crouched fighting stance, the huge forearm planted in front like a gate, feet wide
BREATHING: back rising, gill slits flexing
LUMBER: heavy step, left foot forward, the huge arm swinging
RAISED: rearing up to full height (about 1.3 times the crouched height), the huge forearm lifted, roaring
GATE-ARM TELL: shoulder raised, the huge hand curled back behind the body
GATE-ARM SWEEP: the huge forearm swept forward-left in a broad low horizontal arc, body twisted
SWEEP RECOVERY: head lowered after the swing, the arm dragging on the ground
PRESSURE TELL: gill slits wide open, belly drawn in, chest swelling
PRESSURE RELEASE: jaws wide open, leaning forward, flank exposed (no water drawn)
TAIL TELL: the tail lifted high behind, looking back over the shoulder
TAIL SWEEP: body spun half round, the tail sweeping low behind
BRACE: the huge hand planted flat on the ground in front, dorsal plates flattened, braced against a current
BRACE, GUARD BROKEN: the same brace with the forearm armour plates cracked by dark gaps
RUSH TELL: head lowered, both feet planted, shoulders hunched
RUSH: charging forward head first, the huge forearm leading
WALL RECOVERY: stunned, sitting back, the huge arm slack, head lolling
HURT: recoiling, jaws open, eye shut

DEFEATED: collapsed forward over the huge forearm, tail limp
